papers.title: Diverse-Intent Multi-Turn Fashion Image Retrieval
papers.authors: Mingqiang Tang, Haokun Wen, Meng Liu, Yupeng Hu, Weili Guan, Xuemeng Song
papers.affiliations: Southern University of Science and Technology; Harbin Institute of Technology (Shenzhen); Shandong University; Shenzhen Loop Area Institute
papers.intro: 本文提出了DIM-Fashion基准（26K多轮会话，覆盖7任务）和FashionAM框架（MLLM-VLP直接对齐查询与图库嵌入空间），首次实现了异构意图的多轮时尚图像检索，避免了文本化信息瓶颈。

papers.title: Multimodal Large Language Models for Remote Sensing Image Understanding: Domain-Specific or General-Purpose?
papers.authors: Qiwei Ma, Chunping Qiu, Xinjun Cheng, Xiaoyu Zhang, Puhong Duan, Ke Yang, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li
papers.tags: multimodal learning, scene understanding, visual question answering, visual grounding
papers.affiliations: School of Artificial Intelligence and Robotics, Hunan University (Ma, Duan, Kang, Li); Intelligent Game and Decision Lab (IGDL) (Qiu, Cheng, Zhang, Yang); Yuelushan Center for Industrial Innovation (Kang)
papers.intro: 该论文通过系统性综述和诊断性评估，表明通用CV-MLLMs在多个RSISU任务上可匹配甚至超越专用RS-MLLMs，揭示了当前MLLMs在空间推理、细粒度理解和指令泛化方面的局限性，并提出了可靠评估、高效部署和工具增强代理等未来方向。

papers.title: How Does Urban Context Relate to Residential Building Health? A Vision-POI Fusion Framework for Building-Level Housing Inspection
papers.authors: Kun Zhao, Helei Ren, Guilin Tang, Tianyi Chen, Zhehui Song, Xing Liu, Lijian Zhou, Yuhong Zhao, Xiang Gao, Jinming Jiang, Qichao Ban
papers.affiliations: School of Information Management, Qingdao University of Technology; Embodied AI & Robot Research Institute, Qingdao University of Technology; College of Architecture and Urban Planning, Qingdao University of Technology; Innovation Institute for Sustainable Maritime Architecture Research and Technology (iSMART), Qingdao University of Technology; Department of Urban Planning and Design, Xi’an Jiaotong-Liverpool University
papers.intro: 本研究提出了一个视觉与POI（兴趣点）融合框架，通过多视图视觉聚合和POI上下文特征，评估老旧住宅建筑的健康状况，发现多视图聚合是性能提升的主要来源，而POI信息提供类别依赖的、有限的辅助增益。

papers.title: Vera: Identity-Faithful Human Subject-to-Video Generation
papers.authors: Yulong Xu, Xinyue Liu, Shujuan Li, huafeng shi, Yan Zhou, Jiwen Liu, Xintao Wang, Yu Shen Liu, Huaibo Huang
papers.affiliations: Kuaishou Technology, Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences, Tsinghua University
papers.intro: Vera通过构建百万级跨片段身份对齐数据集，并引入身份聚焦掩蔽监督（IFMS）和参考感知层级注意力（RALA），在单人和多人人类主体到视频生成中实现了高保真身份一致性、正确身份-角色绑定和自然运动。

papers.title: Not All Patches are Equal: Sampling Matters for Visible-Infrared Pre-Training
papers.authors: Qiwei Ma, Bin Deng, Junjie Zhu, Qiangjuan Huang, Puhong Duan, Ke Yang, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li
papers.affiliations: 未明确（但根据正文：Qiwei Ma, Bin Deng, Puhong Duan, Xudong Kang, Shutao Li - 湖南大学（Hunan University）；Junjie Zhu, Qiangjuan Huang, Ke Yang - 智能博弈与决策实验室（Intelligent Game and Decision Lab, Beijing））
papers.intro: 本文提出重要性感知采样（IAS）框架，从采样视角重新审视VIS-IR预训练，通过基于红外结构线索的patch权重、可学习采样模块和课程学习策略，实现按patch可靠性调整训练重点，显著提升下游任务性能。

papers.title: RS-RIE-Bench: Benchmarking Reasoning-Guided Remote Sensing Image Editing
papers.authors: Zihan Qin, Boao Xu, Zhao Dong, Yingping Sun, Ziheng Jiao, Junying Wang, Hongwei Wang
papers.affiliations: Northwestern Polytechnical University (Zihan Qin, Boao Xu, Hongwei Wang), Xi'an Modern Control Technology Research Institute (Zhao Dong), Lanzhou Institute of Physics (Yingping Sun), Huawei Technologies Co., Ltd. (Ziheng Jiao), Fudan University and Shanghai Artificial Intelligence Laboratory (Junying Wang)
papers.intro: 本文提出了RS-RIE-Bench，首个面向推理引导遥感图像编辑的基准，包含486个样本，覆盖时间推理、因果推理和空间推理三类任务，采用三维评估协议（目标区域合理性、非目标区域保持性、图像质量一致性），对8个现有图像编辑模型进行系统评估，发现当前模型在严格联合满意标准下最高准确率仅24.28%。

papers.title: ChronoStitch: Training-Free Composition of Visual KV Memories for Long-Horizon Temporal Reasoning
papers.authors: Santiram Tiwari, Nishant Sinha, Kunal Kislay
papers.affiliations: KGraph AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore, India – 560016
papers.intro: ChronoStitch提出一种免训练的两阶段视觉KV记忆合成方法：先通过三轴mRoPE增量旋转将独立存储的键重定位到全局时间-高度-宽度坐标系，再选择性重计算后续分块中偏差最大的少量视觉token以恢复缺失的跨块注意力，从而在不重新处理整个视频的前提下实现长时程时间推理。

papers.title: BLUE: Semantics-Preserving Video Compression for Efficient Vision-Language Surveillance Analytics
papers.authors: Shubham Baid, Akash James, Sahil Chachra, Nishant Sinha, Kunal Kislay
papers.affiliations: KGraph AI Solutions Pvt. Ltd., Bangalore, India – 560016
papers.intro: 论文提出并评估了一种面向固定摄像头监控视频的机器中心压缩方法 BLUE，它通过持久背景建模和前景保留，在保持 VLM 语义推理质量几乎不变的前提下，降低文件大小并利用跳帧型 P 帧信号减少 VLM 调用次数。

papers.title: Appearance Pointers -- Multimodal Region Control of Diffusion Transformers
papers.authors: Rahul Sajnani, Yulia Gryaditskaya, Radomír Měch, Srinath Sridhar, Matheus Gadelha
papers.tags: image generation, diffusion model, multimodal learning
papers.intro: 本文提出Appearance Pointers——一种紧凑的token表示，通过区域对应网络将文本或图像条件与用户指定的空间掩码对齐，引导扩散Transformer在正确位置使用正确外观线索，无需从头训练基础模型，首次实现模态无关的局部多模态控制。

papers.title: ExpertVerse: A General-Purpose Benchmark for Expert-Level Reasoning in Knowledge-Intensive Visual Synthesis
papers.authors: Yuan Wang, Yongchao Du, Mengting Chen, Jinsong Lan, Xuetao Feng, Xiaoyong Zhu
papers.intro: 本文提出了ExpertVerse，一个面向知识密集型视觉合成的通用能力中心基准，并基于该基准训练了专家知识推理器KnowThinker，通过自主设计的Bootstrapped Pareto Policy Optimization（BPPO）算法解决多奖励优化中的跨模态信用错位与梯度冲突问题。

papers.title: OmniReasoner: Thinking with Long Audio-Video via Native Tool Use
papers.authors: Yu Chen, Caorui Li, Ziyu Xiong, Yidong Wang, Mingqi Gao, Shuman Liu, Biao Liu, Chunfeng Yang, Anxiang Zeng, Haibo Zhang, Chaofan Chen
papers.affiliations: University of Chinese Academy of Sciences (1), Institute of Automation, CAS (2), Southeast University (3), Shopee (4), Tsinghua University (5), Beijing University of Technology (6)
papers.intro: OmniReasoner通过后训练（SFT+RL）教会全模态大语言模型在长音频视频推理中主动调用缩放工具，利用TimeAnchor确保工具时间参数在不同采样粒度下的跨粒度一致性，并通过时序增强数据引擎自动生成工具使用轨迹。

papers.title: ROMS-IMLE: A Minimalist Approach to Competitive Single-Step Generative Modelling
papers.authors: Chirag Vashist, Ke Li
papers.intro: 论文提出ROMS-IMLE，一种基于隐式最大似然估计（IMLE）的极简单步生成模型，通过引入觉察频谱的逐阶段监督和稳健损失函数，在ImageNet 256上达到FID 2.56，参数比DiT-XL/2少54%，生成速度快250倍，证明迭代去噪并非高质量生成所必需。

papers.title: InstructMixup: Instruction-Guided Salient Patch Editing for Robust Data Augmentation
papers.authors: Khawar Islam, Arif Mahmood, Xin Jin, Naveed Akhtar
papers.affiliations: The University of Melbourne; Information Technology University, Lahore; Westlake University
papers.intro: 本文提出InstructMixup，一种完全在单个样本内进行数据增强的方法，它通过指令引导的生成模型编辑多尺度显著区域并重新混合回非显著区域，同时注入自适应分形结构，以极低训练成本产生标签一致且结构多样化的增强样本。

papers.title: ERank in Latent Space as an Image-Complexity and Richness Measure
papers.authors: Maksim Smirnov, Grigory Kononov, Anastasiia Linich, Egor Surkov, Egor Shvetsov
papers.intro: 本文提出基于特征图通道协方差有效秩（ERank）的单样本、无标签视觉丰富度度量，并验证其在图像复杂度排序、数据选择（超分辨率提升、OCR改进）上的有效性，同时指出其适用边界。

papers.title: From Distances to Trajectories: Real-Time Signed Distance Function Mapping and Distance-Accelerated Motion Planning for UAVs
papers.authors: Jason Stanley, Zhirui Dai, Qihao Qian, Tzu-Chin Ho, Tianxing Fan, Siddharth Saha, Christopher Barngrover, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Nikolay Atanasov
papers.affiliations: Jason Stanley, Zhirui Dai, Qihao Qian, Tzu-Chin Ho, Tianxing Fan, Ki Myung Brian Lee, Nikolay Atanasov - Electrical and Computer Engineering Department, UC San Diego; Siddharth Saha, Christopher Barngrover - Shield AI
papers.intro: 本文提出OREN（八叉树残差网络）用于实时、准确、可微的非截断SDF重建，并联合Bubble规划器直接利用SDF距离信息生长无碰撞球（bubble）并构建安全走廊，实现无人机在未知环境中快速、安全的自主飞行。

papers.title: No Training, Better Flights: Test-Time Scaled VLMs for UAV Navigation
papers.authors: Feinan Cheng, Dongliang Xu, Wenli Nong, Zhiheng Zhang, Ang Liu, Tianyu Wang, Yue Yao
papers.affiliations: Feinan Cheng - Shandong University Dongliang Xu - Shandong University Wenli Nong - Shandong University Zhiheng Zhang - Shandong University Ang Liu - China University of Petroleum (East China) Yue Yao - Shandong University
papers.intro: 本文提出一个无需额外训练的三阶段测试时缩放推理框架（并行探索-串行细化-评分选择），使冻结的无人机导航VLM能够自我修正并生成更准确可靠的飞行计划，达到任务最优性能。

papers.title: PathAgentBench: Benchmarking Evidence-Seeking Vision-Language Models on Whole-Slide Pathology Image
papers.authors: Dankai Liao, Tianyi Zhang, Yufeng Wu, Xinyue Zhang, Qiaochu Xue, Zeyu Liu, Dachun Zhao, Linghan Cai, Yueming Jin
papers.tags: medical image, multimodal learning, visual grounding, image retrieval
papers.affiliations: 未明确（正文未提供单一机构列表，详见第十二节）
papers.intro: PathAgentBench基于多尺度诊断树，将WSI诊断分解为证据解释、证据验证、证据获取和证据整合四个互补任务，通过大规模病理学家标注数据评估20个视觉语言模型，发现模型在提供的证据上推理优秀，但证据获取能力严重不足。

papers.title: IGGT4D: Streaming 4D Instance-Grounded Geometry Transformer
papers.authors: Zhengyu Zou, Hao Li, Kuixuan Jiao, Liu Liu, Tingyang Xiao, Xiaolin Zhou, Fangzhou Hong, Zhizhong Su, Dingwen Zhang, Ziwei Liu
papers.tags: 3D reconstruction, pose estimation, instance segmentation, tracking
papers.affiliations: Horizon Robotics; S-Lab, Nanyang Technological University; Institute of Artificial Intelligence, Hefei Comprehensive National Science Center
papers.intro: IGGT4D提出流式实例引导的几何Transformer，通过因果时空建模和在线聚类，从视频流中增量更新相机运动、几何和实例特征的统一表示，并构建大规模4D数据集InsScene4D-147K以支持训练。

papers.title: Context-structured Video Anomaly Detection with Large Vision-Language Models
papers.authors: Dongjun Kim, Changjae Oh, Andrea Cavallaro, Jeonghoon Mo
papers.tags: object detection, tracking, multimodal learning, scene understanding, video search
papers.affiliations: Yonsei University; Queen Mary University of London; EPFL
papers.intro: 本文提出CSI-VAD，一个免训练的视频异常检测框架，通过将视频分解为环境、物体和时间三种不同上下文并分别进行推理，再利用聚合策略得到视频级判断，从而克服整体推理对上下文特定异常线索的遗漏问题。

papers.title: Mitigating Modality and Language-Style Gaps for Zero-Shot Video Moment Retrieval
papers.authors: Jihyun Lee, Cheol-Ho Cho, Woojin Jun, Woojin Jeong, Jae-Pil Heo
papers.affiliations: Sungkyunkwan University, Suwon, Republic of Korea
papers.intro: 本文提出Self-SiMS（Self-Similarity-based Moment proposal and Scoring），通过利用视频内部的自我相似性来生成和评分候选时间段，并辅以查询感知的MLLM重排序，从而在不依赖训练的情况下缓解模态差距和语言风格差距，实现零样本视频时刻检索的SOTA性…
